name: io.github.trhonpavel/medusa-mcp
title: Medusa
description: Medusa v2 store: orders, customers, products, inventory, sales reports and safe write actions.

environmentVariables.name: MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Medusa backend, e.g. https://api.example.com

environmentVariables.name: MEDUSA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret API key from Medusa Admin → Settings → Developer → Secret API Keys (sk_…)

environmentVariables.name: MEDUSA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true = register read and report tools only

environmentVariables.name: REPORT_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for date filters and report buckets, e.g. Europe/Prague
